conventions.lines: 1-based; a line ends at \n or \r\n; a final line without a terminator counts; a BOM is not part of any line
conventions.grades: 2 the answer; 1 useful context; 0 a named distractor (never relevant). Title intent: grade 2 is the whole file
conventions.hit_match: a hit matches a row when root_id and path are equal and the line ranges overlap; a hit takes the highest-grade unmatched row it overlaps and each row is matched at most once
conventions.modes: knowledge = search_knowledge (lexical, top 10, search_field content and both); find:words, find:phrase, find:prefix = find in that mode, first page of 10
conventions.negatives: an empty answer set; rows name the distractors; reported as hit count, top hit and whether it is a named distractor
conventions.checks: asserted by generate.py with the analyzer-v2 simple case fold
